`resetall
`timescale 1ns / 1ps
`default_nettype none

module priority_encoder #(
    parameter WIDTH = 4,
    parameter LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY = 0
)(
    input  wire [WIDTH-1:0] input_unencoded,
    output wire output_valid,
    output wire [$clog2(WIDTH)-1:0] output_encoded,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0] output_unencoded
);

parameter LEVELS = WIDTH > 2 ? $clog2(WIDTH) : 1;
parameter W = 2**LEVELS;

generate
    if (WIDTH == 256 && LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY == 0 && LEVELS == 8 && W == 256) begin : fast_msb256
        wire [15:0] group_valid;
        wire [15:0] group_hot;
        wire [15:0] local_hot [0:15];
        wire [3:0] local_code [0:15];
        wire [15:0] masked_code [0:3];
        wire [3:0] high_code;
        wire [3:0] low_code;
        genvar g, k, b;

        for (g = 0; g < 16; g = g + 1) begin : groups
            wire [15:0] x;
            assign x = input_unencoded[g*16 +: 16];
            assign group_valid[g] = |x;

            // A local empty group has code zero and local one-hot bit zero.
            // Only the selected group is propagated to the outputs.
            for (k = 0; k < 16; k = k + 1) begin : local_priority
                if (k == 0) begin : bottom
                    assign local_hot[g][k] = ~(|x[15:1]);
                end else if (k == 15) begin : top
                    assign local_hot[g][k] = x[k];
                end else begin : middle
                    assign local_hot[g][k] = x[k] & ~(|x[15:k+1]);
                end
            end

            assign local_code[g][0] = |{local_hot[g][15], local_hot[g][13], local_hot[g][11], local_hot[g][9], local_hot[g][7], local_hot[g][5], local_hot[g][3], local_hot[g][1]};
            assign local_code[g][1] = |{local_hot[g][15:14], local_hot[g][11:10], local_hot[g][7:6], local_hot[g][3:2]};
            assign local_code[g][2] = |{local_hot[g][15:12], local_hot[g][7:4]};
            assign local_code[g][3] = |local_hot[g][15:8];

            if (g == 0) begin : bottom_group
                assign group_hot[g] = ~(|group_valid[15:1]);
            end else if (g == 15) begin : top_group
                assign group_hot[g] = group_valid[g];
            end else begin : middle_group
                assign group_hot[g] = group_valid[g] & ~(|group_valid[15:g+1]);
            end

            assign output_unencoded[g*16 +: 16] = local_hot[g] & {16{group_hot[g]}};
            for (b = 0; b < 4; b = b + 1) begin : code_mask
                assign masked_code[b][g] = group_hot[g] & local_code[g][b];
            end
        end

        assign high_code[0] = |{group_hot[15], group_hot[13], group_hot[11], group_hot[9], group_hot[7], group_hot[5], group_hot[3], group_hot[1]};
        assign high_code[1] = |{group_hot[15:14], group_hot[11:10], group_hot[7:6], group_hot[3:2]};
        assign high_code[2] = |{group_hot[15:12], group_hot[7:4]};
        assign high_code[3] = |group_hot[15:8];
        for (b = 0; b < 4; b = b + 1) begin : code_reduce
            assign low_code[b] = |masked_code[b];
        end
        assign output_valid = |group_valid;
        assign output_encoded = {high_code, low_code};
    end else begin : original_generic
        wire [W-1:0] input_padded = {{W-WIDTH{1'b0}}, input_unencoded};
        wire [W/2-1:0] stage_valid [LEVELS-1:0];
        wire [W/2-1:0] stage_enc [LEVELS-1:0];
        genvar l, n;

        for (n = 0; n < W/2; n = n + 1) begin : loop_in
            assign stage_valid[0][n] = |input_padded[n*2+1:n*2];
            if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : lsb
                assign stage_enc[0][n] = !input_padded[n*2];
            end else begin : msb
                assign stage_enc[0][n] = input_padded[n*2+1];
            end
        end

        for (l = 1; l < LEVELS; l = l + 1) begin : loop_levels
            for (n = 0; n < W/(2*2**l); n = n + 1) begin : loop_compress
                assign stage_valid[l][n] = |stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1:n*2];
                if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : lsb
                    assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] = stage_valid[l-1][n*2] ? {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:(n*2)*l]} : {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]};
                end else begin : msb
                    assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] = stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1] ? {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]} : {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:(n*2)*l]};
                end
            end
        end
        assign output_valid = stage_valid[LEVELS-1];
        assign output_encoded = stage_enc[LEVELS-1];
        assign output_unencoded = 1 << output_encoded;
    end
endgenerate
endmodule

`resetall
",
  "bottleneck": "The original implementation propagates encoded bits through a binary priority-multiplexer tree and then decodes that encoded result into 256 one-hot outputs. The resulting serial encode/decode dependency is the primary timing target.",
  "rewrite": "For the specified instance, partition the input into sixteen 16-bit groups. Compute local priority one-hot vectors and local codes in parallel, select the highest-priority nonempty group with parallel suffix reductions, and combine group and local one-hot vectors directly. Form the encoded output independently from the group selection and masked local codes. Retain the original generic implementation for other parameter configurations.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "Expected to reduce maximum arrival time by eliminating the encoded-output-to-one-hot decoder path and replacing cascaded priority multiplexers with parallel reduction and masking logic. No numerical timing improvement is claimed without running the specified mapping flow.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Adds parallel local priority masks and local encoding reductions, while removing the wide final decoder and binary encoded-data selection tree. Area is expected to be competitive with the baseline, but compliance with the 8862.124480 um^2 cap and zero electrical violations requires mapped evaluation; neither has been measured here.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Preserves the module interface, parameter defaults, exposed LEVELS and W parameters, and port widths and signedness. For WIDTH=256 and LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY=0, the highest asserted input wins. With all inputs zero, output_valid is zero, output_encoded is zero, and output_unencoded is 256'b1, matching the original unconditionally decoded default. All other parameter configurations use the original logic, including its padding and truncation behavior. Purely combinational; no assumptions, storage, latency, external includes, or dependencies. Equivalence is intended for every two-state input; formal and mapped checks have not been run."
}
